environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. The /api/report endpoint is exposed to the internet. No query-level firewall or SQL proxy is in the request path.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default forwarding rule, no WAF association
